```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = wk1:wk76,
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  )

billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  filter(week == max(week)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(week == 20) |>
  summarise(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50)
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarise(across(
    c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
    list(
      missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
      present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
    )
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("week", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(wk\\d+)_(missing|present)"
  )
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  arrange(week) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_10_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
  arrange(artist, track)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(first_week_at_best, artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Fastest to No. 1"),
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(desc(first_week_at_best), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Slowest to No. 1"),
  top_10_songs |>
    arrange(desc(total_weeks), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Longest chart run")
) |>
  select(trajectory, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best, total_weeks)

top_10_chart <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(top_10_songs, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank))

notable_chart <- top_10_chart |>
  inner_join(
    notable_songs |>
      mutate(song = paste(track, artist, sep = " — ")) |>
      select(artist, track, song),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

ggplot(top_10_chart, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))) +
  geom_line(color = "grey80", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(
    data = notable_chart,
    aes(color = song),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Chart rank",
    color = "Notable song"
  )

notable_songs
```
